reviews: My desk-mate doesn't eat meat and she had three different curries to choose from: chickpea, paneer and a smoky eggplant one. Full proper plates, not just rice and bread.
Ordered at the counter and had my bowl before my coworker finished paying. Back at the office with twenty minutes of lunch break to spare.
Every pot on the counter is lamb, chicken or beef. My fellow intern who skips meat asked what she could have and they offered her a bowl of plain rice.
They ladle it straight from the pot into a takeaway box. In and out in ten minutes, even at the noon rush.
My manager doesn't eat meat and orders the spinach-and-paneer or the lentil curry every week. Plenty for her to pick from.
Lovely food and the kitchen sends it out in minutes, but it's a treat-yourself lunch: two visits here and my intern stipend felt it.
Came on my lunch break and ended up asking for the curry to go before it even reached the table. Courses come out one at a time, slow and lovely, and I was still late back to the office.
Booked a long Saturday dinner here. My friend who doesn't eat meat had a whole page of lentil, paneer and vegetable dishes to choose from.
The black bean patty is the real deal. My coworker who doesn't eat meat says it's the best burger on the block.
Burger and fries in a paper bag in under five minutes. My go-to when the lunch break is short.
